blocks.text: **Service provisioning and activation** across every network element, from one order. Every step is tracked, retried on failure and recorded.
Remote setup, firmware upgrades and diagnostics for home routers and ONTs, through a **TR-069 ACS** and a **TR-369 USP** controller.
Explore Home Router and ONT Management →

items: **Order:** the BSS or CRM sends one order
**Activate:** Fulfilment Manager configures the AAA, policy, OLT and other network elements
Configure: the home router or ONT receives its baseline settings on first contact (beta)
**Confirm:** the service is tested and the subscriber is told it is live
**Fewer truck rolls:** routers take their baseline settings on first contact and are fixed remotely (beta)
**Fewer stuck orders:** failed steps retry and surface with a reason
**One place to look:** care and NOC teams see every order and every device
**Standard install:** containers and one automated install guide, with rollback ready

items.q: What is service provisioning in telecom?
items.a: Service provisioning sets up a subscriber's service on every network system it depends on, so the service works as soon as it is sold.

items.q: What is the difference between TR-069 and TR-369?
items.a: TR-069 is the established protocol for remote management of home devices. TR-369, also called USP, is its successor and adds real-time control and better scale. Alepo supports both.

items.q: Do you work with our existing routers and network equipment?
items.a: Yes. Both products use standard protocols and connect to equipment from many vendors.
